paragraphs.text: The Mundungu were a group of mages of the Shaper Guild and the Shadow Guild of Zhalfir on Dominaria .

The Mundungu built the tombs of Aku . The city was constructed to hold the pillar tombs of Zhalfirin royalty, preventing them from desecration by grave robbers. Thus, Aku was built in the Uuserk Marshes , the most inhospitable region of Zhalfir. The powerful mages and their flesh-hungry djinn kept the demons of Kaervek away from it during the Mirage War and were instrumental to his defeat.
